incident-bot: INCIDENT 9998886666: elevated 502/504s from inference-gateway in us-west-2. Impact ~13% error rate across model-v2. Pager routed to @elena (oncall).
elena (oncall): Ack — I'm on it. Gathering first-hit logs and dashboard links.
miguel (sre): Confirming spike. I'm seeing segfaults from model-runner pods (us-west-2). Attaching tail of worker logs for the last 2m.
jay (eng-runtime): Logs excerpt:
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:34Z] runner[pid=2345]: SIGSEGV at 0x7fabcdeff
backtrace: quant_attention_kernel+0x1a3 -> run_forward -> model_dispatch
```
rina (eng-ml): We rolled quantized int8 kernels to stable yesterday. This smells like a regression in the quant attention path. Can we route traffic to the fp16 variant while we triage?
elena (oncall): Miguel — can you confirm crash counts and affected nodes? Jay — any quick hotpatch options or safe restarts?
miguel (sre): Crash count: 18 segfaults in last 5m across 4 nodes (node-07, node-10, node-11, node-14). Memory usage normal (not OOM). Restarting affected pods now and enabling core dumps collection.
jay (eng-runtime): Rolling restart started. Bumping replicas +2 to soak traffic. Also applying runtime flag `--disable-quant-attention` for canary instances to test fallback path.
amy (product-ops): Product here — which customers are impacted? Any SLA exposures we need to escalate on the status page?
lucas (support): Support seeing ~7 tickets tied to 502/timeouts. Top affected customers: AcmeAnalytics, ShopFast. Sending short customer-facing note: "We're investigating increased errors; routing to stable model variants; ETA 30-45m." Will update again.
rina (eng-ml): If gateway can fallback routing to `model-v2-fp16` in us-west-2 that should avoid the faulty quant kernel entirely until we fix.
elena (oncall): Implemented routing override: all traffic for model-v2 in us-west-2 -> model-v2-fp16. Observability: error rate dropped 13% -> 4% within 6m. Still seeing isolated 502s originating from node-10.
miguel (sre): Node-10 shows repeated segfaults in `/opt/model/quant_lib.so`. Cordoned node-10 and draining workloads. Collecting core dumps: `/var/crash/core.runner.*` -> uploading to S3 `s3://redwood-incidents/9998886666/cores/`.
jay (eng-runtime): I pulled a core and ran `gdb` quick-check: null pointer in attention kernel when sequence_len > 2048 on the quant path. Hypothesis: quant kernel index math overflow / missing bounds check for long contexts. Hot mitigation: add guard to fallback to fp16 path for seq_len > 1024.
rina (eng-ml): Agree. Quick temporary rule: disable quantized attention for requests with seq_len > 1024. I'll prepare a PR for the runtime to implement the guard and unit test.
elena (oncall): Current mitigation status: routing override in place, rolling restarts complete, node-10 cordoned, guard rule queued. Error rate back near baseline (~1.2%). Marking incident as mitigated; will monitor for 2h then transition to postmortem.
amy (product-ops): I'll draft customer comms and the postmortem doc. ETA for initial postmortem draft: EOD today.
lucas (support): Customer update sent to affected contacts. Support will follow up as tickets update.
incident-bot: INCIDENT 9998886666 - mitigated -> monitoring. Channel will remain open for follow-ups: postmortem, permanent fix, rollout gating for quant kernels.
